name: What parts of a remodel cost the most in luxury homes?

mainEntity.name: What parts of a remodel cost the most in luxury homes?
mainEntity.text: What parts of a remodel cost the most in luxury homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury remodels cost more because multiple high-ticket items stack together. Custom cabinetry, stone slabs, premium flooring, specialty lighting, designer fixtures, and high-end appliances can quickly drive up the budget. Structural changes, expanded openings, or layout reconfiguration add engineering and labor complexity. Fine details such as custom millwork, plaster finishes, integrated systems, and bespoke hardware also increase both material and installation costs. In many high-end Los Angeles homes, the most expensive part is not one single item but the combination of custom design, skilled labor, and coordination across trades. Longer lead times for luxury materials can also increase indirect costs because the project takes more time to manage. Homeowners should expect that the finish level has as much impact on price as square footage does. If you want to control spending, identify the few areas where premium quality matters most and be more practical everywhere else. That approach helps preserve the luxury feel without inflating every line item.
acceptedAnswer.description: In luxury remodels, the biggest costs usually come from custom cabinetry, structural changes, high-end finishes, premium appliances, intricate tile or stone work, and labor coordination. Design complexity and longer timelines also increase total cost.
